name: Remeshing
definition: A post-processing step designed to reduce the distance error (εm) and normal deviation (σm) from offset meshes to the exact offset, reconstruct sharp features (e.g., concave creases), and improve triangle shape quality.
summary: Remeshing post-processes offset meshes to reduce error, reconstruct sharp features, and eliminate self-intersections, unlike Alpha Wrapping or raw Minkowski sums.
